page_title: Pie Menu - the radial menu for Mac

sources.entry: Pie Menu – Control your tools with a radial menu customized for your active app.

summary.name: Pie Menu
summary.one_liner: Pie Menu is a radial menu app for Mac that opens a ring of customizable shortcuts around the cursor, tailored to whichever app is active.
use_cases: Trigger frequently used app actions without memorizing shortcuts
Use one global shortcut to open per-app action menus
Customize menu appearance with colors and shapes
summary.what_it_does: Pie Menu opens a radial menu around the mouse cursor when you press a single chosen shortcut (the page's example is holding shift + z). The menu shows the shortcuts for the currently active app, so the same trigger offers different actions in different programs. You can pick your own trigger combination and assign icons from Apple's SF Symbols or your own images and SVGs. Menus can open other menus as submenus to group related actions. Colors and menu shape can be set, and the page mentions community-made themes.
notable: Context-aware: menu contents change with the active app
Icons from Apple SF Symbols or custom images/SVGs
Nested submenus open from within a pie menu
Customizable colors, shapes and community themes
caveats: Mac only; the page names no other platforms
Pricing is not stated on the page
